name: Castle
flavor: Plain stone and stubbornness. It has never once had an idea, and it has never once fallen for lack of one.

name: Collapsed Mine
flavor: What's left of the vault is worth exactly one coin — but it's one coin nobody else starts with.

name: Plains Terrace
flavor: Open ground favors whoever steps onto it first. +1 Attack to the very first unit you play this match.

name: Outskirts Watchtower
flavor: The first thing anyone sees past the castle walls, and the last thing raiders want to.

name: Hedgerow Burrow
flavor: Dug deep under the thistles. Everyone who comes out of it is a little tougher.

name: Tidewall Fort
flavor: Every tide washes the cracks back full of sand.

name: Drowned Bellhouse
flavor: Half under water, and still somehow collecting rent.

name: Ashen Bastion
flavor: Built from cooled lava by someone who never once lost an argument.

name: Lantern Warren
flavor: A cave full of lanterns, and everything that flies towards them.

name: Acacia Kraal
flavor: Thorn walls, one shade tree, and a view of everything coming.

name: Wolfsbane Lodge
flavor: Logs as thick as a bear, and a fire that has never gone out.

name: Coral Spire
flavor: It grows a little every year. So does everyone who lives in it.

name: Bog Stilt-House
flavor: The swamp keeps trying to swallow it. The swamp keeps losing.
